company_line: Civilivic is a South East Queensland civil contractor delivering roads, drainage, earthworks and civil infrastructure, and this role is open to an experienced Site Engineer or a Graduate Engineer.
subject: Site Engineer or Graduate Engineer, Gympie (SEEK)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Site Engineer role in Gympie advertised on SEEK. Your advert says a graduate here works on site with the people building the job, doing take-offs, quality records, subcontractor coordination and inspections. That is the kind of start I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also lodged Before You Dig enquiries and designed around existing services.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and am available for site and regional work. My site experience is about ten months and overseas, so ITPs, progress claims and variations in an Australian contract are things I would be learning from your team.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
